{{Main|Equipment}}
'''Shakudo equipment''' is [[Copper equipment|copper equipment]] upgraded with [[Shakudo Alloy|shakudo alloy]], a copper and gold alloy. Its tools have [[Silk Touch]], its axe, sword and spear steal life, and its armor regenerates health, [[Cleanse|cleanses]] effects and gives [[Magic protection|magic protection]].

== Obtaining ==
Shakudo alloy is crafted from four blocks of copper and two blocks of gold. Copper equipment is upgraded at a [[Smithing Table|smithing table]] with no template ([[Smithing Upgrade Template|template]] for the dolabra and mattock). It is repaired with blocks of copper. There is also a [[Elytra#Shakudo Elytra|shakudo elytra]].

== Intrinsics ==
* '''Tools''' have Silk Touch.
* '''Axe, sword and spear''' give the wielder Regeneration III for 1 second on each hit.
* '''Armor''': each piece cleanses one kind of effect (helmet: Blindness and Darkness; chestplate: Poison; leggings: Slowness; boots: Levitation), gives magic protection 8, and counts towards the regeneration bonus: Regeneration I for 3 seconds every 30, 26, 22 or 18 seconds with one to four pieces.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/stopwatches.mcfunction}}</ref>

The video describes shakudo as "a gold-copper alloy that cleanses malefic, steals life from mobs, and whose tools have silk touch as an intrinsic."<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Shikudo, a gold-copper alloy that cleanses malefic, steals life from mobs, and whose tools have silk touch as an intrinsic.}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Shakudo armor could not be crafted; this was fixed. Fixed the shakudo sword; its life steal no longer works on armor stands.}}
{{History line|1.10|Shakudo was renamed from "Palatinate" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Shakudo alloy became more expensive: 3 gold and 6 copper ingots became 2 blocks of gold and 4 blocks of copper. Buffed shakudo armor: added the regeneration ability and the per-piece bonus.}}
{{History line|1.12|Fixed severe multiplayer lag caused by shakudo armor. The shakudo spear's real attack speed now matches its tooltip.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Shakudo intrinsics are now exclusive with the electrum and adamant intrinsics. Shakudo armor was nerfed.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|The shakudo chestplate no longer cleanses the [[Wither effect|Wither effect]]. Dolabras were redefined as axe (tool) and pickaxe hybrids rather than weapons: damage goes down and weapon intrinsics are removed over time.}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* Shakudo was called "Palatinate" until 1.10; the rename happened only in the language file, and the advancement for smithing it is still called "Palatinate Perfection".
